notes.title: Patch 3.0.351.5517
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed inventory not working with native linux player
[*]Fixed missing cursor on fight scene near end
[*]Fixed spanish subtitles not shown in videos
[*]Fixed syncing achievements with steam - this will hopefully fix missing endurance achievement (maybe you have to start game twice to unlock it)
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix #1 for Patch 3.0.351.5509
notes.content:
[*]Fixed unlocking extras picture 6 and 7 when loading a late game savefile
[*]Hopefully fixed an issue near the end of the game

notes.title: Patch 3.0.351.5509
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed videos on linux
[*]Fixed videos on mac
[*]Fixed a rare crash when loading an old savegame
[*]Fixed a rare crash when starting the game
[*]Fixed an issue that caused flickering fonts on steamdeck

[*]Fixed an issue that prevents unlocking picture 6 and 7 in the extras menu (you have to progress through the game or load/continue a late savegame to get them unlocked)
[*]Fixed an issue that caused no interaction possible when skipping to fast in first cutscene
[*]Fixed an issue that caused Gleeman not clickable
[*]Fixed missing dialog when talking to Gram
[*]Fixed an issue near the end of the game (no spoiler here)

[*]Removed Visionaire Configuration Tool from starting options
[/list]

The Visionaire Configuration Tool was made as a little helper for technical issues many years ago. Most of the settings are handled ingame or by the engine itself now. As the tool is not needed anymore for daily use, we decided to remove the tool from the starting options and just keep it in the local game files.

[*]Fixed wrong background music loop
[*]Fixed rare black screen (maybe you have to restart twice until fix is working)

notes.title: Patch 3.0.351
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added linux/steamdeck support.
[*]Added gamepad support.
[*]Added native touch input support for steamdeck.
[*]Activated cloud saves.
[*]Updated engine.
[*]Reworked codebase.
[*]Reworked pathfinding.
[*]Major and minor bugfixes.
[/list]

[h1]Happy Holidays![/h1]

notes.title: If you have technical issues
notes.content:
Please note that we cannot offer official technical support on this board, except for posting the latest patch notes.

[h1]But your games and my computer don’t work as a team! Where can I get help?[/h1]
We do offer technical support. Just not in forums. Please contact our colleagues from the support via mail using [url=mailto:support@daedalic.de] support@daedalic.de[/url]. However, feel free and use this forum (or our [url=http://forum.daedalic.de/index.php]official forum[/url]) to address your technical problem. We are certain that many players of our games are able to help you out with certain problems.  

[h1]What can I do to speed up the support process?[/h1]
In order to speed up the process our support needs information of your running system and the game (version) you are playing. So [url=http://forum.daedalic.de/viewtopic.php?f=145&t=1530]please read before reporting technical issues to us[/url].

Thank you very much for your ongoing support!


Best regards,
your Daedalic Entertainment Community Team
